links.outcome: Differences in AI care intensity across simulated patient age and household economic status
links.effect: Disparities were observed by patient age and household economic status; older and wealthier patients received more intensive care.
links.quote: Disparities were observed based on patient age and household economic status, with older and wealthier patients receiving more intensive care.

unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM chatbot diagnosis and prescribing against human physicians under standardized conditions, including measuring unnecessary tests and medications (overprescription)

screen.reason: Evaluates the quality, safety, and demographic disparities of LLM chatbots (ERNIE Bot, ChatGPT, DeepSeek) using simulated patient experiments for chronic disease management without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
